@Night_House_Pro @hale_charlie @kyriii @elonmusk Proof of work model (which validates transactions to be recorded on the public ledger for a given crypto) requires that the energy use increases at an exponential rate. While a proof of stake model grows linearly. 

Bitcoin uses proof of work, but dogecoin uses proof of stake.
